description: Purpose-written fictional handbook cases. Expected answers are human-readable references, not generated ground truth. Labels fixed before evaluation.

cases.question: Can an editor change billing or delete the workspace?
cases.expected_output: No. Only owners manage billing or delete a workspace. Editors can create and update projects and tasks.

cases.question: I accidentally threw away a project yesterday. Can we get it back, and who can do it?
cases.expected_output: An owner can restore the project from the recycle bin within 30 days, including tasks and documents. After 30 days it is permanently deleted.

cases.question: My contractor's invitation link is eight days old and no longer works. What should I do?
cases.expected_output: Guest invitations expire after seven days. Ask the owner to send a new invitation.

cases.question: Can I get a refund for a renewal payment?
cases.expected_output: No. Renewal payments are not refundable under the illustrative policy. The 14-day full refund applies only to the first payment.

cases.question: If we stop renewing today, do our paid tools disappear immediately?
cases.expected_output: No. Cancellation stops the next renewal, but paid features remain until the current billing period ends. It does not delete projects.

cases.question: Before closing the workspace, will the downloaded project JSON contain the actual attachment files?
cases.expected_output: No. Project JSON includes tasks and document text, but attachments are only download links. Download attachments separately before deleting the workspace.

cases.question: I silenced a project but somebody tagged me and I still got an email. Is that expected?
cases.expected_output: Yes. Muting stops project activity notifications, but direct mentions still send an email.

cases.question: Is there weekend phone support?
cases.expected_output: No. Support operates Monday to Friday, 09:00–17:00 UTC, excluding public holidays. Urgent email reports are reviewed in the next support window.

cases.question: What is the capital of France?
cases.expected_output: Paris is the capital of France. This is general knowledge, not information from the Atlas handbook.

cases.question: Why does the Moon have phases?
cases.expected_output: The Moon's phases result from seeing different portions of its sunlit half as it orbits Earth. This is general knowledge, not information from the Atlas handbook.
